reviews.author: Jae Cha
reviews.text: Carlos has been taking care of my neighbor’s lawn for years, and after seeing how consistently great their yard looked, I decided to hire him for my own. I’m so glad I did. He’s been maintaining our lawn for the past few years now, and the difference is noticeable, our grass looks healthier, cleaner, and better cared for than it has in a long time. Carlos is incredibly thorough with every visit. He doesn’t rush, he pays attention to the details, and he treats the property like it’s his own. On top of that, he’s reliable, easy to communicate with, and always professional. It’s rare to find someone who takes this much pride in their work. Highly recommend Carlos and Bluegrass Lawn Care to anyone looking for quality, consistent lawn care.

reviews.author: barkay wolfsohn
reviews.text: I highly recommend Carlos and his team for any lawn care needs! I've been working with him for the last two years, and he is doing a fantastic job. He's always punctual, and the results are great, our grass looks green and healthy, and I'm very happy with his work.

reviews.author: Leon Stallings
reviews.text: Bluegrass lawn care is amazing. I have used Carlos for the last 12 years. Started with my house in Nutley where he completely turned my landscaping around. My neighbors all asked who was doing my lawn and most started to use him. He did everything from bushes to trees to flowers. Now I use him in Saddle Brook and already I have the best lawn in the neighborhood. He even made a really nice design on my shrubs that make the backyard really pop. I highly recommend Bluegrass for your landscaping needs. I would never use someone else.

reviews.author: Sharad
reviews.text: I have been using Carlos and his team for the last 4 years and I have been very happy with his services. They are very professional, willing to listen and don’t cut any corners. I have also recommended them to my friends in town.

reviews.author: Jae Woo Lee
reviews.text: Carlos and his team were great, very detailed and helpful. They’ve put down the lawn renovation so far and cleared out the yard well for spring cleaning. Looking forward to the results.
